346005.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">1%</style> Attack SPD increases the <style="accent-gn">Crimson Recovery</style> effect by <style="accent-gn">1%</style> while within <style="accent-gn">Crimson Earth</style>.

348005.name: Raging Flame Sharpness II

Every 1% Crimson Soul Gauge provides 0.2% Crit Rate.

344005.name: Raging Flame Sharpness I
344005.desc: For every <style="accent-gn">10%</style> Max HP lost, immediately grants 1 stack of a buff that increases Crit Chance gained from all sources by <style="accent-gn">2.5%</style> for <style="accent-gn">5</style>s. This effect can stack up to <style="accent-gn">3</style> times.

348005.name: Raging Flame Sharpness I
348005.desc: For every 10% Max HP or Crimson Soul Gauge lost, immediately gains a buff: Increases Crit Rate bonuses from all sources by 1% for 5s. Stacks up to 3 times.

2256.name: Energy Saving
2256.desc:
When consuming Frost Crystal to cast Frost Lance, refunds 50% of the Ice Energy consumed after the cast.
When casting Frost Lance without consuming Frost Crystal, an additional 50% of the Ice Energy consumed is deducted after the cast.

223027.name: Luck Damage

Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier +15%.

227027.name: Quick Frozen Blast

942001.name: Star Fury
942001.desc: Increases <linktext=1537><style="ItemQuality_5">Star Shatter</style></linktext> and <linktext=1594><style="ItemQuality_5">Starfall</style></linktext> DMG by <style="accent-gn">30%</style>, and guarantees <linktext=1135><style="ItemQuality_5">Enraged</style></linktext> status.

941001.name: Recovery
941001.desc: <style="accent-gn">Each</style> successful hit of <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> or <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style> increases <style="accent-gn">Strength</style> by <style="accent-gn">1%</style> in <style="accent-gn">5s</style>. With <style="accent-gn">10</style> stacks, increases <style="accent-gn">Strength</style> by <style="accent-gn">10%</style> for <style="accent-gn">8s</style>. During this effect, the next <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> heals you for <style="accent-gn">20%</style> of the DMG dealt, yet no additional <style="accent-gn">Strength</style> stacks can be gained.

940001.name: Bash Pursuit
940001.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">50</style> times damage is taken, the next <linktext=1540><style="ItemQuality_5">Shield Bash</style></linktext> deals additional fixed damage equal to <style="accent-gn">100%</style> HP + <style="accent-gn">300%</style> of current shield amount (shield amount cannot exceed <style="accent-gn">150%</style> Max HP). 939001.name: Enrage Delay
939001.desc: When <style="accent-gn">Strength</style> reaches <style="accent-gn">500</style>, extends the duration of <linktext=1135><style="ItemQuality_5">Enraged</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">1</style> second.

42031.name: Fang of the Alpha
42031.desc: Reduces the DMG Elites or stronger enemies deal to you by 12%.

37118.name: Shadow Veil
37118.desc:
Each enemy within 3 meters increases your Block chance by 3%, up to 15%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.) Remains unchanged when Earthfort Spec is active.
If Block Spec is activated, the effect becomes: Every enemy within 3 meters increases Block DMG Reduction by 1%, up to 5%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.)

928019.name: Group Suppress
928019.desc: Each enemy within <style="accent-gn">3</style> meters enhances the effectiveness of <linktext=1122><style="ItemQuality_5">Suppress</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">3%</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">15%</style>. This effect is doubled against Elite or stronger enemies.

928020.name: Group Suppress

1492.name: Resonant Domain

934004.name: Sandstone Shock

933004.name: Sandstone Rewind
933004.desc:
When Rageblow deals DMG, it reduces the CD of Brave Bastion by 3s.

932008.name: Resonant Domain
932008.desc: <linktext=1536><style="ItemQuality_5">Cracking Echo</style></linktext> generates a <linktext=1137><style="ItemQuality_5">Sandfield</style></linktext> that lasts for <style="accent-gn">5</style>s.

932007.name: Block Blessing

912027.name: Stone Fragment Tide

911012.name: Survival Instinct
911012.desc: When HP falls below <style="accent-gn">30%</style>, triggers <linktext=1129><style="ItemQuality_5">Survival Instinct</style></linktext>, once every <style="accent-gn">60</style>s.

906012.name: Block Recovery
906012.desc:
Successful Block restores 1% of your HP and 2 Rage. This can only occur once per second.
Triggering Lucky Block restores 2% of your HP and 4 Rage. This can only occur once per second.

925017.name: Survival Instinct
925017.desc: When HP falls below <style="accent-gn">30%</style>, triggers <linktext=1129><style="ItemQuality_5">Survival Instinct</style></linktext>, once every <style="accent-gn">60</style>s.

925018.name: Counter Storm
925018.desc: For <style="accent-gn">10s</style> after casting <linktext=1536><style="ItemQuality_5">Cracking Echo</style></linktext>, trigger <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1125><style="ItemQuality_5">Countercrush</style></linktext> every <style="accent-gn">2s</style>.

1359001.name: Multi-Target Heat Amp
1359001.desc: <linktext=1608><style="ItemQuality_5">Passion Burst</style></linktext> and its enhanced version (<linktext=1617><style="ItemQuality_5">Passion Fury</style></linktext>) deal <style="accent-gn">5%</style> more DMG <style="accent-gn">per</style> additional target hit, up to <style="accent-gn">25%</style>.

1357001.name: Spiral Flame
1357001.desc: After casting <linktext=1610><style="ItemQuality_5">Center Stage</style></linktext>, summon a wave of <linktext=1173><style="ItemQuality_5">Sonic Surge</style></linktext>.

1356001.name: Tower Flame Blast

931006.name: Earthfort Spec

Further enhances the ability to use Shield Bash.

Replaces Special Attack with Countercrush, and enhances the ability.

921007.name: Breath of Stone

922007.name: Shield Echo

917007.name: Smash Support
917007.desc: Increases the effectiveness of Shield granted by <linktext=1540><style="ItemQuality_5">Shield Bash</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">30%</style>.

1260001.name: Adversity Enhancement
1260001.desc: <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style> and damaging <style="accent-gn">Expertise</style> are enhanced based on missing HP. For every <style="accent-gn">1%</style> HP lost, increases their DMG by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>.

1258001.name: Determination Slash
1258001.desc: When <linktext=1175><style="ItemQuality_5">Lightforged Barrier</style></linktext> has <style="accent-gn">5</style> or fewer stacks, taking DMG no longer reduces its stacks. When <linktext=1175><style="ItemQuality_5">Lightforged Barrier</style></linktext> has more than <style="accent-gn">5</style> stacks, taking DMG has a <style="accent-gn">50%</style> fixed chance not to reduce its stacks.

224027.name: Continuous Stream
224027.desc:
Dealing DMG triggers Trickle.
Trickle: Grants a 1% Ice damage bonus for 6s, stacking up to 5 times.

231003.name: Frostjade Staff
231003.desc:
When Ice Arrow cast with Ice Crystal Core deals DMG, restores 1 Ice Energy.
In the Permafrost status, the recovery doubles.

5581.name: Frost Domain
5581.desc: The area of <linktext=1516><style="ItemQuality_5">Glacier Hymn</style></linktext> -<style="accent-gn">50%</style>. While within the domain, you gain a <style="accent-gn">25%</style> Ice bonus.

1123011.name: Valiant Heart

1128011.name: Sundering Arrow

1127011.name: Arrow Barrage

5550.name: Tracer Arrows
5550.desc: While <linktext=1138><style="ItemQuality_5">Photon Reforge</style></linktext> is active, for <style="accent-gn">each</style> beast on the battlefield, <linktext=1601><style="ItemQuality_5">Storm Arrow</style></linktext> fires <style="accent-gn">1</style> extra <linktext=1142><style="ItemQuality_5">Lightseeker Arrow</style></linktext> (up to <style="accent-gn">4</style> arrows).

364005.name: Arcane Wildfire Bloodline
364005.desc: When <linktext=1626><style="ItemQuality_5">Wildfire Dance</style></linktext> deals DMG, there is a fixed chance of <style="accent-gn">12%</style> + Haste% / <style="accent-gn">2</style>.<style="accent-gn">5</style> to gain <style="accent-gn">1</style> stack of <style="accent-gn">Crimson Bloodline</style>. 3180.name: Arcane Wildfire Bloodline
3180.desc: When Wildfire Dance deals Crit DMG, there is a 20% fixed chance to accumulate 1 stack of Crimson Bloodline on the target that lasts for 5s. When Crimson Bloodline reaches 8 stacks, it triggers Hellfire Meteor and clears the Crimson Bloodline stacks.

352005.name: Hellfire Manifestation

169001.name: Moonblade Swift
169001.desc: <linktext=1101><style="ItemQuality_5">Moonblades</style></linktext> additionally deal <style="accent-gn">1</style> instance of Whirling DMG every <style="accent-gn">6s</style>. Each <style="accent-gn">2%</style> Haste reduces its CD by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>.

167001.name: Thunderstrike Whisper
167001.desc: Increases the Thunder DMG <linktext=1100><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunderstrike</style></linktext> deals by <style="accent-gn">50%</style>, yet <linktext=1100><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunderstrike</style></linktext> never deals Crit DMG.

165001.name: Charge Catcher

163001.desc:
Increases the DMG dealt by Thunderstrike by 20%.
Each 1% Luck grants Thunderstrike 1% more DMG dealt.

Lightning damage +20%.

162001.name: Chaos Breaker

161001.name: Duel Awareness

160001.name: Power of Thunder

Thunder Power: Thunder DMG +28, lasts for 10s, stacks up to 10 times.

157001.name: Touch of Thunder Soul

When Moonblades land a Lucky Strike, they have a fixed 60% chance to cast Thunderstrike on a Lucky Strike.

1353001.name: Crit Scale

Increases Crit Rate by 10% against enemies above 50% HP.

154001.name: Wind Assault II

1352001.name: Tower Resonance

148003.name: Zen Moment

1351006.name: Crescendo Healing Chord
1351006.desc:
Healing Melody gains 7% Healing Strength for every second it remains active, stacking up to 5 times.

147002.name: Thunder Reversal
147002.desc:

Thunder Reversal: Gain a 10% Thunder DMG bonus for 15s.

146002.name: Thunder Sigil Affinity

141002.name: Wind Assault I

139002.name: Thunder Might

Casting Dracoflash or Phantom Slash extends Volt Surge's duration by 1.2s.

137004.name: Swift Blade

124029.name: Thunder Sigil Charm
124029.desc:
Increases Max Thunder Sigil by 1.

124028.name: Thunder Sigil Rewind

134026.name: End of Annihilation

113018.name: Bladewind Domain
113018.desc:
Every 3 casts of Overdrive allows the next Iaido Slash to generate a Bladewind Domain in front.

110019.name: Thundrage
110019.desc:
Each use of Dracoflash or Phantom Slash grants 4 stacks of Thundrage, up to 8 stacks.
Greatly increases the Casting SPD of Thunder Cut.

106018.name: Dual Blade Intent

When Blade Intent is at least 100, Flash Strike, Raijin Dash, and their enhanced skills (Dracoflash, Phantom Slash) +10% Crit and +20% Thunder DMG.
When Blade Intent is at least 100, greatly increases Flash Strike's and Raijin Dash's casting speed.

128029.name: Break Slash

126028.name: Frenzied Thunder Roar

5212.name: Iaido Mastery
5212.desc:
Iaido Slash Crit +10%.

133002.name: Unmatched Raijin Dash
133002.desc:
Raijin Dash and its enhanced skill (Phantom Slash) ignore the target's Armor.
Raijin Dash and its enhanced skill (Phantom Slash) deal 20% more damage per additional 1 enemy hit (up to 200%).

132003.name: Flash Sharp Strike
132003.desc:
Triggers Sharp Strike when casting Iaido Slash and its enhanced skill (Thunder Cut).
Sharp Strike: Increases Crit Rate of Flash Strike and its enhanced skill (Dracoflash) by 10%. If Flash Strike and its enhanced skill (Dracoflash) deals Crit DMG 1 time, gains 1 Thunder Sigil. This effect is removed after the use of Flash Strike and its enhanced skill (Dracoflash) or after 10s.

6309.name: Raijin Dash Charge

7244.name: Blade Intent Recovery

7240.name: Moonstrike Delay

121011.name: Breath of Mark
