130003.name: Iaido Slash Spec
130003.desc:
Further enhances the ability to use Iaido Slash.
When the number of Thunder Sigils consumed by Iaido Slash and its enhanced skill (Thunder Cut) equals the current maximum Thunder Sigil count, increases the DMG of Iaido Slash and its enhanced skill (Thunder Cut) by 12% and grants Super Armor during the cast.

Consume as many Thunder Sigils as possible to deliver a powerful blow to the target with Iaido Slash. High Crit and Mastery allow Iaido Slash to deal greater DMG and more hits. Under certain conditions, Iaido Slash no longer needs to be channeled.

8470.name: Flash Frenzy Blade
8470.desc: When <linktext=1500><style="ItemQuality_5">Iaido Slash</style></linktext> and its enhanced skill (<linktext=1588><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Cut</style></linktext>) deal DMG, there is a fixed <style="accent-gn">10%</style> chance to reset the remaining CD of <linktext=1501><style="ItemQuality_5">Flash Strike</style></linktext> and <linktext=1554><style="ItemQuality_5">Raijin Dash</style></linktext>. For <style="accent-gn">each</style> <linktext=1104><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Sigil</style></linktext> consumed, the chance increases by <style="accent-gn">10%</style>. During <linktext=1504><style="ItemQuality_5">Volt Surge</style></linktext>, this chance is doubled.

8468.name: Infinite Thunder
8468.desc: For every <style="accent-gn">5</style> <linktext=1104><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Sigils</style></linktext> consumed, the remaining CD of <linktext=1504><style="ItemQuality_5">Volt Surge</style></linktext> -<style="accent-gn">0.5s</style>.

7356.name: Fire Day
7356.desc: Increases Fire Bonus by <style="accent-gn">8%</style> when attacking Elite or higher targets.

6568.name: Passion Fury
6568.desc: For each <style="accent-gn">10</style> <style="accent-gn">Performance Passion</style> consumed, enhances <linktext=1608><style="ItemQuality_5">Passion Burst</style></linktext> to <linktext=1617><style="ItemQuality_5">Passion Fury</style></linktext> for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.

6567.name: Stat Resonance
6567.desc: While <linktext=1606><style="ItemQuality_5">Healing Melody</style></linktext> is active, grants appropriate buffs (<style="accent-gn">Strength</style>, <style="accent-gn">Intellect</style>, <style="accent-gn">Agility</style>) equal to <style="accent-gn">8%</style> of your <style="accent-gn">Intellect</style> to up to 20 allied targets, prioritizing party members. (Buffs from different Beat Performers cannot stack. Only the one with the highest value applies.)

1319006.name: Rhythm Spirit
1319006.desc: Defeating an enemy has a fixed <style="accent-gn">50%</style> chance to grant you <style="accent-gn">1</style> <style="accent-gn">Performance Passion</style>.

2406.name: Brilliant Charge
2406.desc: When <linktext=1609><style="ItemQuality_5">Healing Beat</style></linktext> or <linktext=1608><style="ItemQuality_5">Passion Burst</style></linktext> applies Crit Healing or deals Crit DMG (triggers only once when hitting multiple targets), gains <style="accent-gn">1</style> <style="accent-gn">Performance Passion</style>.

1327011.name: Sonic Delay
1327011.desc: Applying a <linktext=1192><style="ItemQuality_5">Note</style></linktext> to a target extends the duration of the buffs granted by Finale Command by <style="accent-gn">0.3</style>s, but the buffs are only <style="accent-gn">50%</style> as effective during the extended duration.

1329011.name: Concerto
1329011.desc:
During Rhapsody of Flame, Amplified Beat gains 1 additional attack.
Amplified Beat's DMG -20%.

1316006.name: Flame Note
1316006.desc: When you use an <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style>, <linktext=1603><style="ItemQuality_5">Rhapsody of Flame</style></linktext> will erupt with Rhythm, dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">700%</style> of ATK and granting <linktext=1192><style="ItemQuality_5">Note</style></linktext> to allies it touches.

1311006.name: Encore Persistence
1311006.desc:
Permanently benefits from Encore effect.
For every 5 triggers of Encore Strings, the next Amplified Beat and Harmonic Anthem deal 50% more DMG.

1314006.name: Flame's Rampage
1314006.desc:
When Heroic Melody is active, Rhapsody of Flame will erupt, dealing Magic DMG equal to 350% ATK every 3s to targets it touches (DMG interval affected by Haste). This DMG can trigger Lucky Strike.
While in Rhapsody of Flame, each hit of Harmonic Anthem also heals 1 ally with the lowest HP for 30% of the DMG dealt (this value scales proportionally when hitting multiple targets).

1313006.name: Lucky Soundwave
1313006.desc: Gains <style="accent-gn">1</style> <style="accent-gn">Soundwave Energy</style> whenever <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style>s or <linktext=1604><style="ItemQuality_5">Amplified Beat</style></linktext> trigger a Lucky Strike.

1330011.name: Resonant Counterpoint
1330011.desc: When a <linktext=1192><style="ItemQuality_5">Note</style></linktext> forms, there's a <style="accent-gn">50%</style> fixed chance to create an extra <linktext=1192><style="ItemQuality_5">Note</style></linktext> for a different target.

1315006.name: Luck Multiplier
1315006.desc:
Every 1% Luck grants 0.5% Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier.
After activating Heroic Melody, doubles its conversion efficiency.

1309006.name: Restart
1309006.desc: When <linktext=1605><style="ItemQuality_5">Harmonic Anthem</style></linktext> or <linktext=1615><style="ItemQuality_5">Fierce Strike</style></linktext> triggers a Lucky Strike, limited to a single activation when striking multiple targets, immediately resets <linktext=1603><style="ItemQuality_5">Rhapsody of Flame</style></linktext>'s CD and allows <linktext=1603><style="ItemQuality_5">Rhapsody of Flame</style></linktext> not to consume <style="accent-gn">Performance Passion</style> for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>, this effect is nullified upon casting <linktext=1603><style="ItemQuality_5">Rhapsody of Flame</style></linktext>.

1308006.name: Dissonance Spec
1308006.desc:
While in Rhapsody of Flame, increases all Luck Chance acquired by any means by 50% and increases DMG Reduction by 25%.

Healing of Stillness: If you deal no DMG to enemies for 5s, each hit of your Basic Attack will heal up to 10 allies (party members prioritized), with the full 4-hit combo restoring 15.75% of their max HP in total. After casting an Ultimate, Basic Attacks immediately start healing, and Fierce Strike can trigger the 4th hit healing effect, but this is disabled upon dealing DMG to enemies.

Maintaining Heroic Melody and Rhapsody of Flame is crucial. Heroic Melody enhances healing while consecutive Fierce Strikes accelerate Harmonic Anthem casting frequency.

1300006.name: Passion Surge
1300006.desc:
When Melody is active, there is a 15% fixed chance per second to gain Passion Surge.

Passion Surge: Special Attack costs zero Performance Passion for 10s. Removed after Special Attack is cast.

5547.name: Legendary Beast
5547.desc:
Casting Wildcall summons a Legendary Companion based on current Photon Energy: If Photon Energy is below 50%, summons Legendary Eagle. If Photon Energy reaches 50% or more, summons Legendary Boar.
Wildcall now holds up to 2 charges.

360005.name: Crimson Epiphany
360005.desc: When the <style="accent-gn">Crimson Soul Gauge</style> is full, your next instance of damage no longer grants <style="accent-gn">Bloodboil</style>. When you cast an Ultimate while the <style="accent-gn">Crimson Soul Gauge</style> is full, you immediately enter <style="accent-gn">Bloodboil</style>. While <style="accent-gn">Bloodboil</style> is active, you gain an additional <style="accent-gn">15%</style> Fire Bonus.
Every 1% Mastery grants 2% Crimson Recovery final effect.

361005.name: Wildfire Dance Final Slash
361005.desc:
After Wildfire Dance deals Crit DMG 10 times (hits on multiple targets count as one), it triggers a Final Slash that deals 500% ATK as Attack DMG to enemies.
Each Crit DMG instance dealt by Wildfire Dance grants the Final Slash a 3% Final DMG Bonus (up to a maximum of 100%).

Adds a final slash to Wildfire Dance, dealing 500% ATK as Attack DMG to enemy targets.
Each instance of Crit DMG dealt by Wildfire Dance increases the Final DMG of the final strike by 3% (max 100%).

326005.name: Wasteland Finale
326005.desc: Gains <style="accent-gn">25%</style> Fire Bonus for <style="accent-gn">15</style>s after casting Ultimate.
Gains 25% Fire Bonus for 15s after casting Ultimate.

347006.name: Unbound Meteor Combo
347006.desc:
Falling Hellfire is enhanced into a continuous three-hit strike form.
Every 1% Crimson Soul Gauge increases Falling Hellfire DMG by 1%.

desc.name: Crimson Earth Meteor I
desc.desc:
Unbound Meteor charge count +2.
Within Crimson Earth, Unbound Meteor evolves into Falling Hellfire with +300% Crit DMG.

323005.name: Double Inferno
323005.desc:
Axe Wind applies 3 stacks of Burn to hit targets.
At S Formless level, targets hit by Axe Wind accumulate 1 stack of Wildfire that lasts for 10s. When Wildfire reaches 12 stacks, it triggers Explosion and clears Wildfire stacks.

321005.name: Time Wheel Agile Soul
321005.desc: Each <style="accent-gn">1</style> level of the <style="accent-gn">Formless</style> effect grants <style="accent-gn">2.5%</style> <style="accent-gn">Strength</style>.

314005.name: Soaring Flame
314005.desc:
After gaining Formless 6 times or activating Wasteland's End, Blazing Ascension evolves into Soaring Flame.
Gains Blaze after casting Soaring Flame.

329005.name: Formless Combo
329005.desc: For every <style="accent-gn">5</style> hits an <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> deals to the main target, it grants a buff that increases the Lucky Strike Multiplier by <style="accent-gn">27%</style> and reduces Lucky Strike Crit Rate by <style="accent-gn">20%</style> for the next <style="accent-gn">8s</style>. This effect stacks up to <style="accent-gn">3</style> times.

310005.name: Crimson Lotus Ember Epiphany
310005.desc: While in the <linktext=1211><style="ItemQuality_5">Infernal Combo</style></linktext> state, the <linktext=1218><style="ItemQuality_5">Flame Suppression</style></linktext> effect is increased by <style="accent-gn">50%</style>.

306005.name: Crimson Lotus Duality
306005.desc:
Each stack of Infernal Combo grants effects based on the relationship between Luck Chance and Crit Chance:

When Luck Chance is greater than or equal to Crit Chance, each stack of Infernal Combo grants 1.6% Lucky Strike Multiplier.
When Crit Chance is greater than Luck Chance, each stack of Infernal Combo grants 1.2% Crit DMG.

303005.name: Crimson Lotus
303005.desc:
Gain adaptive effects when Infernal Combo reaches max stacks:

Formless Spec: ATK +8%.
Crimson Spec: Crimson Recovery effect +10%.

304005.name: Crimson Flame Pursuit
304005.desc: <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style> hits cause the target to take +<style="accent-gn">2.5%</style> DMG. The effect lasts <style="accent-gn">8</style>s and stacks up to <style="accent-gn">3</style> times.

307005.name: Flame Soul Seal
307005.desc:
Flame Soul cap +50.
Every 50 Flame Soul gained triggers Infernal Combo.

570001.name: Rescue
570001.desc: Healing <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> restore <style="accent-gn">25%</style> more HP to the targets with HP below <style="accent-gn">50%</style>.

569001.name: Energy Expansion
569001.desc:
Increases Max Energy by 20.
Using Blossom Charge restores 30% lost Energy.

568001.name: Healing Pulse
568001.desc: When an enemy within <style="accent-gn">10</style> meters that you are engaged with is defeated (effective within a team), generates a <linktext=1110><style="ItemQuality_5">Healing Pulse</style></linktext>. This can only occur once every <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.

567001.name: Floral Whisper
567001.desc: Healing <style="accent-gn">Expertise</style> generate <style="accent-gn">20%</style> more healing, but healing from <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> -<style="accent-gn">50%</style>.

564001.name: Instant Bloom
564001.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">5</style> uses of <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> accelerates the using of <linktext=1534><style="ItemQuality_5">Grove Wish</style></linktext> or <linktext=1532><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Pulse</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">100%</style> and increases their Healing by <style="accent-gn">50%</style> in <style="accent-gn">15s</style>.

563001.name: Tricolor Revelation
563001.desc:
Consumes Moonlight Solace to trigger Flower Time Dance - Tricolor Revelation (only takes effect if you have the "Flower Time Dance" talent).
Flower Time Dance - Tricolor Revelation: Grants the effects of all the Flower Stalks, up to once every 60s.

562001.name: Energy Arcane
562001.desc:
During Fast Growth, increases Energy REG SPD by 50%.
Increases Grove Wish's Crit by 10%

561001.name: Blooming Reincarnation
561001.desc: Casting <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> increases <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext>'s healing by <style="accent-gn">20%</style> and its <style="accent-gn">Energy</style> consumed by <style="accent-gn">10%</style> for <style="accent-gn">4s</style>. This effect can stack up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times.

560001.name: Flourishing Progress
560001.desc: When holding <style="accent-gn">2</style> or more <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Buds</style></linktext>, casting <linktext=1533><style="ItemQuality_5">Blossom Charge</style></linktext> for damage or healing always triggers a corresponding seed (without costing <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Buds</style></linktext>) and grants <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Bud</style></linktext>.

558001.name: Endless Blossom
558001.desc: When casting <linktext=1533><style="ItemQuality_5">Blossom Charge</style></linktext>, <linktext=1534><style="ItemQuality_5">Grove Wish</style></linktext>, or <linktext=1532><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Pulse</style></linktext>, <style="accent-gn">20%</style> chance that the next cast of <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> within <style="accent-gn">5</style>s consumes no <style="accent-gn">Energy</style>.

556001.name: Verdant Nourishment
556001.desc:
If you're affected with Nourish, reduces all DMG taken by 10%.
If the targets are affected by Nourish, enhances their Healing Received from yourself by 5%. If the stack of Nourish is above or equal to 3, additionally enhances Healing Received by 3%.

555001.name: Wild Luck
555001.desc: When <linktext=1526><style="ItemQuality_5">Wild Bloom</style></linktext> or <linktext=1532><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Pulse</style></linktext> deal DMG, grants a chance (equal to the <style="accent-gn">half</style> percentage of Luck) to gain <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Bud</style></linktext>. If the target is affected by <linktext=1117><style="ItemQuality_5">Thorn</style></linktext>, doubles the chance.

554001.name: Thornbreaker
554001.desc: <linktext=1530><style="ItemQuality_5">Infusion</style></linktext> and <linktext=1593><style="ItemQuality_5">Stag Charge</style></linktext> deal <style="accent-gn">100%</style> more Final DMG to <linktext=1117><style="ItemQuality_5">Thorned</style></linktext> targets (each <style="accent-gn">1%</style> of Mastery grants an additional <style="accent-gn">4%</style>), but the healing conversion of <linktext=1530><style="ItemQuality_5">Infusion</style></linktext> and <linktext=1593><style="ItemQuality_5">Stag Charge</style></linktext> is halved.

553001.name: Thorn
553001.desc:
When Wild Seed hits a target, it inflicts Thorn on them.
Forest DMG dealt by players to targets with Thorn +20%.

552001.name: Swift Shelter
552001.desc:
Each use or trigger of Regen Pulse reduces the CD of Nature Ward by 2s.
Nature Ward grants Super Armor while active.

551001.name: Lucky Pulse
551001.desc: Lucky Strike DMG <style="accent-gn">+30%</style>, but the Inspiration talent is disabled.

550001.name: Breath of Symbiosis
550001.desc:
Symbiotic Mark increases converted healing by 2%. Each 5% Mastery grants an additional 1%.
Symbiotic Mark also grants 2% Max HP for 5s (duration cannot be refreshed when reapplied).

549001.name: Swift Bud
549001.desc: <style="accent-gn">Each</style> <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Bud</style></linktext> gained, reduces the CD of <linktext=1529><style="ItemQuality_5">Feral Seed</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">1</style> second.

548001.name: Verdant Impact
548001.desc: For every <style="accent-gn">20</style> stacks of <style="accent-gn">Pulse Echo</style> gained, the next actively cast <linktext=1532><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Pulse</style></linktext> triggers a <linktext=1533><style="ItemQuality_5">Blossom Charge</style></linktext> at both the nearest enemy and the Ally with lowest HP.

1112010.name: Wolf Evolution
1112010.desc: <style="accent-gn">Wild Wolf</style> evolves into its <style="accent-gn">Adult Form</style>, increases DMG by <style="accent-gn">30%</style>, DMG Range by <style="accent-gn">50%</style>.

1106010.name: Battle Howl
1106010.desc: While <linktext=1549><style="ItemQuality_5">Wildcall</style></linktext> is active, the <style="accent-gn">Wild Wolf</style> is bound to deal Crit DMG on hit.

1105010.name: Lumi Torrent
1105010.desc:
While in Photon Reforge state, Torrent Volley continuously charges. After 30s of charging, Torrent Volley evolves into Lumi Torrent.
Upon casting Lumi Torrent, immediately gain full Photon Energy.

1109010.name: Direwolf Bite
1109010.desc: <style="accent-gn">Wild Wolf</style>'s <style="accent-gn">Coordinated Attack</style> has a <style="accent-gn">50%</style> fixed chance to inflict <linktext=1141><style="ItemQuality_5">Bleed</style></linktext>.

1111010.name: Stomp
1111010.desc: Casting <linktext=1549><style="ItemQuality_5">Wildcall</style></linktext> again within <style="accent-gn">10s</style> of its initial cast commands all beasts on the field to immediately cast <linktext=1145><style="ItemQuality_5">Stomp</style></linktext>.

1110010.name: Demon Wolf Twin
1110010.desc: When <linktext=1601><style="ItemQuality_5">Storm Arrow</style></linktext> deals DMG in battle, it has a fixed <style="accent-gn">10%</style> chance to summon a <style="accent-gn">Wild Wolf</style> for <style="accent-gn">8</style>s. This effect can occur once every <style="accent-gn">40s</style>.

1108010.name: Phantom Wolfstrike
1108010.desc:
Every 2s, DMG dealt by Wild Wolf's Coordinated Attack or Tail Sweep summons a Phantom Direwolf to attack the target with Pounce and Bite. After each Special Attack cast, the Phantom Direwolf's DMG +100%, stacking up to 5 times. The Phantom Direwolf disappears after dealing DMG.
Pounce and Bite is guaranteed to inflict Bleed. If the target is already Bleeding, Pounce and Bite is bound to deal Crit DMG on hit.

1126010.name: Wildpack Spec
1126010.desc:
Further enhances Storm Arrow and the Wild Wolf's power.
Storm Arrow always deals 200% Crit DMG on critical hits.
While Photon Reforge is active, the chance for the Wild Wolf to trigger Coordinated Attack is increased to 100%.

The Wild Wolf becomes empowered, and Haste allows both you and the wolf to attack more frequently.

1102010.name: Overcharge
1102010.desc: When <style="accent-gn">Basic Attacks</style> deal DMG, there is a <style="accent-gn">5%</style> fixed chance to instantly grant <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style> 1 charge, up to the maximum charge limit.

1125010.name: Photon Limit
1125010.desc:
Increases Max Photon Energy by 20, extending the duration of Photon Reforge. Unaffected when Wildpack Spec is active.
If Falconry Spec is activated, the effect becomes: Max Photon Energy -20 but Photon Reforge state can be entered more quickly.

1104009.name: Rapid Shot
1104009.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">5%</style> Haste provides an additional <style="accent-gn">1%</style> attack speed.

25095.name: Wolf Pact
25095.desc:
Tames a Wild Wolf to fight alongside you. Storm Arrow has a 30% fixed chance to trigger Coordinated Attack.

Wild Wolf
A Wild Wolf fights alongside you.
Basic Attack: Sweeps the enemy, dealing Attack DMG equal to 60% ATK (which scales with the Level/Tier of your Basic Attack).
Coordinated Attack: Wild Wolf leaps to the enemy and bites, dealing Attack DMG equal to 100% ATK (which scales with the Level/Tier of your Basic Attack).

1205008.name: Haste Sigil
1205008.desc: Each <style="accent-gn">1%</style> Haste increases the recovery speed of <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style> by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>. Recovery time = Initial recovery time / (<style="accent-gn">1</style> + recovery speed bonus).

1207008.name: Condemn Time Limit
1207008.desc: When <linktext=1598><style="ItemQuality_5">Condemn</style></linktext> deals damage, it immediately cools down <style="accent-gn">1</style> <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style> (prioritizing the <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style> with the longest remaining CD).

1202009.name: Blessing of Holy Sigil
1202009.desc: When using a Skill that consumes <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigils</style>, <style="accent-gn">20%</style> chance for your next <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style>-consuming skill to consume no <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigils</style>. The effect lasts for <style="accent-gn">8</style>s or until a <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style>-consuming skill is cast.

1201008.name: Condemn
1201008.desc: When casting a skill that consumes <style="accent-gn">Photon Energy</style>, there is a <style="accent-gn">30%</style> fixed chance for <style="accent-gn">Basic Attacks</style> to evolve into <linktext=1598><style="ItemQuality_5">Condemn</style></linktext>.

1602.name: Holy Summon
1602.desc: When <linktext=1562><style="ItemQuality_5">Shield Toss</style></linktext> or <linktext=1564><style="ItemQuality_5">Judgment</style></linktext> deals DMG, <style="accent-gn">10%</style> chance to trigger <linktext=1177><style="ItemQuality_5">Divine Strike</style></linktext>. If Crit DMG is dealt, the chance increases to <style="accent-gn">50%</style>.

8684.name: Aegis Ward's Anthem
8684.desc: For every <style="accent-gn">2</style> <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigils</style> consumed, the remaining CD of <linktext=1565><style="ItemQuality_5">Aegis Ward</style></linktext> -<style="accent-gn">1</style> second.

40076.name: Sword Dance
40076.desc: When a <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> critically heals, gain a <style="accent-gn">15%</style> healing bonus.

34158.name: Fearless Shield
34158.desc: Each time <linktext=1562><style="ItemQuality_5">Shield Toss</style></linktext> deals DMG, gain a <linktext=1172><style="ItemQuality_5">Radiant Shield</style></linktext> equal to <style="accent-gn">13.75%</style> Armor (affected by Versatility and Element bonuses; can Crit and is affected by Crit DMG).

6457.name: Holy Light Time Limit
6457.desc: During <linktext=1565><style="ItemQuality_5">Aegis Ward</style></linktext>, when an <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> deals Crit DMG, there's a <style="accent-gn">50%</style> fixed chance to instantly reset <style="accent-gn">1</style> <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style> CD (prioritizing <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style> with the longest remaining CD). This effect triggers only once when multiple targets are hit.

1203009.name: Lightforged Fortitude
1203009.desc: Throughout the duration of <linktext=1172><style="ItemQuality_5">Radiant Shield</style></linktext>, <linktext=1170><style="ItemQuality_5">Block</style></linktext> chance +<style="accent-gn">10%</style>.

2252.name: Cold Retention
2252.desc: In the <linktext=1515><style="ItemQuality_5">Permafrost</style></linktext> status, the cost of <linktext=1509><style="ItemQuality_5">Frostbeam</style></linktext> decreases by <style="accent-gn">25%</style>.

212017.name: Frostbeam Spec
212017.desc:
Replaces Special Attack with ​Frostbeam​ and enhances the skill.
Every Frost Crystal increases ​Frostbeam​ DMG by 15%. Each 10% Mastery grants an additional 0.85% DMG bonus (up to 5%) and increases the Ice Energy consumed by 30%.
When ​Frostbeam​ hits a target, every 13 hits reduce the remaining CD of Permafrostby 1s (hitting multiple targets only counts once).

Consumes Ice Energy to channel Frostbeam continuously at the target. High Haste and Mastery greatly speed up its channeling while improving Ice Energy recovery.

223026.name: Frost Tide
223026.desc: When dealing DMG, <linktext=1509><style="ItemQuality_5">Frostbeam</style></linktext> has a fixed <style="accent-gn">20%</style> chance to grant <linktext=1161><style="ItemQuality_5">Frost Crystal</style></linktext>. If Max <linktext=1161><style="ItemQuality_5">Frost Crystal</style></linktext> is reached, grants <style="accent-gn">5%</style> bonus Ice damage dealt instead for <style="accent-gn">3s</style>.

227026.name: Frost Revelation
227026.desc:
The first hit of Tidepool on the target grants 5 Ice Energy. Each additional Frost Crystal increases Ice Energy restored by 10.
During Permafrost, Tidepool does not go on CD. During ​Frostbeam, tap Tidepool again to adjust its position.

224026.name: Continuous Stream
224026.desc:
Dealing DMG triggers Trickle.
Trickle: Grants a 1% Ice damage bonus for 6s, stacking up to 5 times.

228026.name: Icy Calm
228026.desc: Each additional target hit by an <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> or <style="accent-gn">Ultimate</style> grants a <style="accent-gn">2%</style> bonus to your highest stat among Mastery, Haste, Crit, or Luck for <style="accent-gn">5</style>s. Hitting more than 5 additional targets still only counts as <style="accent-gn">5</style>.

210017.name: Intellect Ice Crystal
210017.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">50</style> <style="accent-gn">Intellect</style> grants <style="accent-gn">1</style> Max <style="accent-gn">Ice Energy</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">100</style> from this source.

206017.name: Tide Mastery
206017.desc: While casting <linktext=1509><style="ItemQuality_5">Frostbeam</style></linktext>, you can channel <linktext=1508><style="ItemQuality_5">Tidepool</style></linktext> and <linktext=1558><style="ItemQuality_5">Maelstrom</style></linktext>.

209017.name: Endless Tide
209017.desc: During <linktext=1515><style="ItemQuality_5">Permafrost</style></linktext>, each <style="accent-gn">Ice Arrow</style> triggered by <style="accent-gn">Ice Crystal Core</style> extends the duration of <linktext=1515><style="ItemQuality_5">Permafrost</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">0.5s</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">5s</style>.

211017.name: Cold Wind Convergence
211017.desc:
When Frozen Gale hits a target (only triggers once when hitting multiple targets), it consumes all Frost Crystals to summon Icy Bolt, with the number of Icy Bolt equal to the consumed Frost Crystals.
Icy Bolt deals DMG, restores 5 Ice Energy, and reduces the Ice Energy cost of skills by 3% for the next 15s, stacking up to 6 times.

202027.name: Frost Curse Sigil
202027.desc: When a <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style> deals DMG, it has a fixed <style="accent-gn">5%</style> chance to <linktext=1171><style="ItemQuality_5">Frozen</style></linktext> the target.

225026.name: Crystal Resonance
225026.desc:
When ​Frostbeam​ deals damage, it has a fixed 30% chance to make Ice Crystal Core fire an Ice Arrow. Up to 1 Ice Arrow can be fired every 0.5s.
The Final DMG of Ice Arrow is increased (Ratio = Mastery% × 1.6; DMG triggered by Frost Explosion talent is also affected).

208017.name: Frost Explosion
208017.desc: When <style="accent-gn">Ice Arrows</style> fired by <style="accent-gn">Ice Crystal Cores</style> deal a Crit, they deal an additional instance of <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">28%</style> ATK. This DMG can trigger Lucky Strike.

201034.name: Intellect Conversion
201034.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">10</style> points of Intellect provides <style="accent-gn">1</style> point of MATK.

200019.name: Secondary Amp
200019.desc: Boost the highest stat among the following <style="accent-gn">5</style> stats: Crit, Haste, Luck, Mastery, and Versatility by <style="accent-gn">3.5%</style> as a final value.

21226.name: Ice Revelation
21226.desc:
Summons 2 permanent Ice Crystal Cores that float beside you.
Ice Crystal Core
When Basic Attacks deal DMG, Ice Crystal Cores have a fixed 10% chance to fire 2 Ice Arrows.
Ice Arrow: Each arrow deals Magic DMG equal to 28% ATK to the target and grants 1 Frost Crystal (up to 2 Frost Crystals can be stored).

8467.name: Rapid Thunder Assault
8467.desc: <style="accent-gn">Each</style> additional <linktext=1104><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Sigil</style></linktext> consumed by a skill increases its DMG by <style="accent-gn">3%</style>.

5210.name: Instant Slash
5210.desc: <linktext=1500><style="ItemQuality_5">Iaido Slash</style></linktext> reduces the Armor of the target hit by <style="accent-gn">6%</style>. The effect lasts <style="accent-gn">5s</style> and stacks up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times.

23249.name: Keen Strike
23249.desc: When <style="accent-gn">Basic Attacks</style> deal DMG, <style="accent-gn">10%</style> chance to trigger <linktext=1096><style="ItemQuality_5">Piercing Slash</style></linktext>, once <style="accent-gn">per</style> second.

104018.name: Blade Intent
104018.desc: <style="accent-gn">3</style> points of <linktext=1167><style="ItemQuality_5">Blade Intent</style></linktext> are gained when an <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> is cast.

102007.name: Thunder Charm Blade
102007.desc:
For each 1 Thunder Sigil consumed by Expertise Skill, gain an additional 3 points of Blade Intent.
For every consumption of Blade Intent, grants 20% DMG Reduction for 5s.

5597.name: Vacuum Slash
5597.desc:
Each cast of Flash Strike, Raijin Dash, or its enhanced skills grants 1 stack of Thundrage. When Thundrage reaches 5 stacks, Iaido Slash evolves into Thunder Cut.
After casting Thunder Cut, 5 stacks of Thundrage are consumed. Thundrage stacks up to 8 times.

5596.name: Violent Slash
5596.desc: Increases the critical rate of <linktext=1500><style="ItemQuality_5">Iaido Slash</style></linktext> and <linktext=1588><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Cut</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">12%</style>.

5593.name: Blade Intent Thunderstrike
5593.desc: When <linktext=1500><style="ItemQuality_5">Iaido Slash</style></linktext> deals Crit DMG, if the <linktext=1167><style="ItemQuality_5">Blade Intent</style></linktext> exceeds <style="accent-gn">20</style>, launches <linktext=1100><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunderstrike</style></linktext> (which can only be triggered once per use of <linktext=1500><style="ItemQuality_5">Iaido Slash</style></linktext>).

109017.name: Thunder Sigil Rewind
109017.desc: When consuming <linktext=1104><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Sigils</style></linktext>, there is a chance to return <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1104><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Sigil</style></linktext>, and for each additional <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1104><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Sigil</style></linktext> consumed, the return chance +<style="accent-gn">9%</style>.

100022.name: Keen Enhancement
100022.desc: Increases the fixed chance to trigger <linktext=1096><style="ItemQuality_5">Piercing Slash</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">10%</style>.

23247.name: Iai Thunder Dance
23247.desc: When <linktext=1104><style="ItemQuality_5">Thunder Sigils</style></linktext> are at <style="accent-gn">3</style> or higher, <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style> hits <style="accent-gn">twice</style> times consecutively.

41038.name: Shadow Veil
41038.desc:
Each enemy within 3 meters increases your Block chance by 3%, up to 15%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.) Remains unchanged when Earthfort Spec is active.
If Block Spec is activated, the effect becomes: Every enemy within 3 meters increases Block DMG Reduction by 1%, up to 5%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.)

6067.name: Stone Domain
6067.desc:
Throughout the duration of Sandshroud, being attacked reduces the attack speed of enemy targets within a 5 meter radius by 30% for 3s.
throughout the duration of Sandshroud, Armor of allies within an 8 meter radius +10%.

41037.name: Fang of the Alpha
41037.desc: Reduces the DMG Elites or stronger enemies deal to you by 12%.

914007.name: Starfall
914007.desc: For every <style="accent-gn">20</style> <style="accent-gn">Sand Crystals</style> consumed, <linktext=1537><style="ItemQuality_5">Star Shatter</style></linktext> evolves into <linktext=1594><style="ItemQuality_5">Starfall</style></linktext>.

923013.name: Countercrush
923013.desc:
A successful Block triggers a Countercrush, once per second.
On a Lucky Block, randomly triggers 1 to 3 Countercrush, once per second.

6064.name: Granite
6064.desc: After casting <linktext=1597><style="ItemQuality_5">Stone Fist</style></linktext>, for the next <style="accent-gn">10s</style>, summons <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1131><style="ItemQuality_5">Granite</style></linktext> every <style="accent-gn">2s</style>.

913016.name: Granite Fury Pursuit
913016.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">50</style> times damage is taken, the next <linktext=1539><style="ItemQuality_5">Granite Fury</style></linktext> deals additional fixed damage equal to <style="accent-gn">7,000%</style> of Armor. Can trigger at most once every <style="accent-gn">20</style>s. Every <style="accent-gn">2%</style> Mastery reduces the required times of damage taken by <style="accent-gn">1</style>. Every <style="accent-gn">1%</style> Luck reduces the trigger interval by <style="accent-gn">1%</style> (up to <style="accent-gn">50%</style>).

907011.name: Rock Heart
907011.desc:
Every 10 casts of ​Granite Fury​ grant Rock Heart.
Rock Heart: For 10s, ​Granite Fury​ evolves into Stone Fist.
When Rock Heart activates, grants 10% Rock Bonus for 10s.
Casting Stone Fist guarantees Enraged.

900301.name: Sandstone Revival
900301.desc: For each <style="accent-gn">1</style> <style="accent-gn">Sand Crystal</style> consumed, restore <style="accent-gn">1%</style> of Max HP.

903011.name: Weakness Strike
903011.desc: When dealing DMG, <style="accent-gn">Basic Attacks</style> have a fixed <style="accent-gn">10%</style> chance to trigger <linktext=1123><style="ItemQuality_5">Weakness Strike</style></linktext> once.

22087.name: Rage Awakening
22087.desc: Consuming <style="accent-gn">Rage</style> has a chance to enter <linktext=1135><style="ItemQuality_5">Enraged</style></linktext> state for <style="accent-gn">5s</style>. The more <style="accent-gn">Rage</style> you consume, the higher the chance. <style="accent-gn">Each</style> <style="accent-gn">Rage</style> increases the chance by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>.

6056.name: Valiant Fury
6056.desc: When <linktext=1135><style="ItemQuality_5">Enraged</style></linktext>, you gain <style="accent-gn">30%</style> bonus Armor, decreasing by <style="accent-gn">5%</style> per second.

6055.name: Granite Combo
6055.desc: When <linktext=1131><style="ItemQuality_5">Granite</style></linktext> deals DMG, there is a chance, of which equals Luck Chance, to summon <style="accent-gn">an additional</style> <linktext=1131><style="ItemQuality_5">Granite</style></linktext>.

546001.name: Arcane of Green
546001.desc: When <linktext=1529><style="ItemQuality_5">Feral Seed</style></linktext> deals DMG, it increases ATK by <style="accent-gn">Mastery% x Luck%</style> for the next <style="accent-gn">10</style>s.

545001.name: Pulse Breath
545001.desc: While in combat, if <linktext=1532><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Pulse</style></linktext> is equipped, <linktext=1535><style="ItemQuality_5">Nature Ward</style></linktext> and <style="accent-gn">Ultimates</style> will trigger <linktext=1532><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Pulse</style></linktext> whenever their CDs are completed.

543001.name: Wild Protection
543001.desc:
The charge count of Nature Ward +1.
The charge time of Nature Ward decreases by 5s.

542001.name: Feral Seed Symbiosis
542001.desc: When active <style="accent-gn">Symbiotic Marks</style> reach <style="accent-gn">5</style> or more, <linktext=1529><style="ItemQuality_5">​Feral Seed​</style></linktext> and <linktext=1116><style="ItemQuality_5">Wild Seed</style></linktext> DMG increases by <style="accent-gn">100%</style>.

541001.name: Wide-area Thorns
541001.desc:
When Feral Seed hits the primary target, it spreads the primary target's Thorn effect to other targets within 10 meters.
Attacking Elite or stronger targets grants 8% Forest Bonus.

540001.name: Luck Damage
540001.desc:
Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier +5%.
Every 1% Luck grants 1.5% Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier.

537001.name: Energy Surge
537001.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">2%</style> haste provides <style="accent-gn">1%</style> <style="accent-gn">energy</style> natural recovery efficiency.

536001.name: Dancing Seed
536001.desc:
When a DMG-type Expertise Skill triggers Lucky Strike, next Wild Seed launches 1 more projectile.
For every 5 Nourishing Seeds thrown, next Nourishing Seed throws 1 more projectile.

7303.name: Pulse Retrospect
7303.desc:
Regen Pulse returns to your position after it reaches the max distance.
Regen Pulse now deals DMG to enemies.

525014.name: Natural Bloom
525014.desc: When healing an ally with lower than <style="accent-gn">30%</style> HP, <style="accent-gn">Natural Bloom</style> triggers, instantly restoring HP equal to <style="accent-gn">200%</style> ATK to them. This effect can occur up to once every <style="accent-gn">30s</style>.

525013.name: Verdant Blessing
525013.desc:
When HP of an ally with Inspiration drops below 20%, Blessing triggers.
Blessing: Grants a Nature Shield and reduces the DMG taken by 35% for 8s, once every 60s.

533001.name: Bloomheal
533001.desc:
Replaces Ultimate, Divine Circle Bloom, with Bloomheal.
For 10s after casting Bloomheal, doubles the effect of Inspiration, but your Final DMG dealt is reduced by 10%.

524014.name: Flourish
524014.desc: When <linktext=1530><style="ItemQuality_5">Infusion</style></linktext>, <linktext=1529><style="ItemQuality_5">Feral Seed</style></linktext>, or <linktext=1526><style="ItemQuality_5">Wild Bloom</style></linktext> deals DMG, <style="accent-gn">30%</style> chance to reduce the CD of the <style="accent-gn">Ultimate</style> by <style="accent-gn">1</style>s, once <style="accent-gn">per</style> second.

528017.name: Bud Acquisition
528017.desc: When an enemy within <style="accent-gn">10</style> meters that you are engaged with is defeated (effective within a team), generates an <linktext=1114><style="ItemQuality_5">Engram Orb</style></linktext>, which grants <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Bud</style></linktext> upon pickup.

526016.name: Symbiosis Extension
526016.desc: Each <linktext=1116><style="ItemQuality_5">Wild Seed</style></linktext> fired extends the duration of activated <style="accent-gn">Symbiotic Mark</style> by <style="accent-gn">1s</style>.

2249.name: Stag Charge
2249.desc:
After triggering a total of 10 Nourishing Seeds or Wild Seeds, Wild Bloom evolves into Stag Charge.
Casting Stag Charge instants grants 3 Regen Buds.

506014.name: Pulse Echo
506014.desc:
When dealing DMG, Infusion grants 1 stack of Pulse Echo.
Pulse Echo: Increases DMG dealt of Regen Pulse by 20%, which lasts 12s and stacks up to 5 times.

523015.name: Double Infusion
523015.desc: After casting <linktext=1593><style="ItemQuality_5">Stag Charge</style></linktext>, the number of channels for the next <linktext=1530><style="ItemQuality_5">Infusion</style></linktext> +<style="accent-gn">100%</style>.

512014.name: Shelter
512014.desc: Within <style="accent-gn">5s</style> after Casting <linktext=1530><style="ItemQuality_5">Infusion</style></linktext>, the damage absorption of the <linktext=1111><style="ItemQuality_5">Nature Shield</style></linktext> added by <linktext=1526><style="ItemQuality_5">Wild Bloom</style></linktext> or <linktext=1535><style="ItemQuality_5">Nature Ward</style></linktext> is doubled.

509014.name: Wings of Revival
509014.desc:
When an ally within 20 meters takes DMG exceeding 30% of their HP, Revival triggers, which can affect the same target up to once every 45s.
Revival: Restores HP equal to 50% of the DMG taken over 5s.

508014.name: Wild Blessing
508014.desc:
Wild Bloom now holds up to 2 charges.
Wild Bloom's Energy cost -15%.

5532.name: Regeneration Bud
5532.desc: When dealing damage with <style="accent-gn">Basic Attacks</style>, <style="accent-gn">10%</style> chance to gain <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Bud</style></linktext>.

532003.name: Pulse Duality
532003.desc: When <linktext=1532><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Pulse</style></linktext> is actively used, it spreads <style="accent-gn">twice</style>.

519003.name: Bud to Blossom
519003.desc: When a <style="accent-gn">Flower Stalk</style> appears, grants <style="accent-gn">1</style> <linktext=1108><style="ItemQuality_5">Regen Bud</style></linktext> every <style="accent-gn">2s</style> for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.

518003.name: Verdant Duet
518003.desc: <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> has a fixed <style="accent-gn">20%</style> chance to heal <style="accent-gn">1</style> additional time.

516003.name: Life Bloom
516003.desc: Using <linktext=1533><style="ItemQuality_5">Blossom Charge</style></linktext> enhances the next <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext>, skipping the cast and increasing the Healing by <style="accent-gn">50%</style>.

515003.name: Full Bloom
515003.desc:
Casting Life Bloom grants a 40% chance to reduce the remaining CD of Blossom Charge and Nourish by 2s. Each 1% of Mastery increases this chance by 0.4%, up to a maximum of 60%.
Casting Life Bloom grants a 50% chance to reduce the remaining CD of Fast Growth by 0.2s, triggering at most once every 10s. Each 20% of Haste increases the CD reduction by 0.1s, up to a maximum of 0.5s.

522004.name: Nourish Essence
522004.desc: When <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> generates healing, <style="accent-gn">50%</style> chance to apply <linktext=1528><style="ItemQuality_5">Nourish</style></linktext>.

514003.name: Healing Infusion
514003.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">5</style> uses of <linktext=1527><style="ItemQuality_5">Life Bloom</style></linktext> enhances the next direct healing <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style> by <style="accent-gn">100%</style>.

520003.name: Lifeforce Extension
520003.desc:
Increases the Healing of Healing Chain by 10%. For every 7% Mastery, Healing Chain jumps 1 additional time.
Healing Chain restores 1% of an ally's Max HP with each tick.

531002.name: Lifebind Spec
531002.desc:
Replace Special Attack with Life Bloom and enhances the skill.
Life Bloom generates 20% more healing.
Casting Life Bloom grants 1 additional Regen Bud.

Whenever safety allows, aim to cast as many healing skills as possible. Haste increases cast speed, and Mastery enhances healing potency.

5523.name: Vitality
5523.desc:
Nourish can stack up to 5 times.
Each use of Life Bloom grants targets affected by Nourish 1 stack of Nourish and increases their Max HP by 2% for 5s (the duration cannot be refreshed when reapplied, and this Max HP increase cannot take effect at the same time as the one granted by Breath of Symbiosis).

40024.name: Flower Time Dance
40024.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">45</style>s (for every <style="accent-gn">1%</style> Haste, generation speed increases by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>), generates <style="accent-gn">1</style> <style="accent-gn">Flower Stalk</style> in the following order: <linktext=1119><style="ItemQuality_5">Crimson Insight</style></linktext>, <linktext=1120><style="ItemQuality_5">Golden Devotion</style></linktext>, and <linktext=1121><style="ItemQuality_5">Moonlight Solace</style></linktext>.

2243.name: Verdant Root
2243.desc:
While in battle state, standing still for 2s creates a Grass Domain.
Grass Domain: While inside the Grass Domain, your Haste +10%. Upon exiting the Grass Domain, your Movement SPD +50% for 0.5s, and Grass Domain disappears.

527013.name: Gift of Life
527013.desc: When an enemy within <style="accent-gn">10</style> meters that you are engaged with is defeated (effective within a team), generates a <linktext=1113><style="ItemQuality_5">Healing Orb</style></linktext>. This can only occur once every <style="accent-gn">2s</style>.

524013.name: Wings of Revival
524013.desc:
When an ally within 20 meters takes DMG exceeding 30% of their HP, Revival triggers, which can affect the same target up to once every 45s.
Revival: Restores HP equal to 50% of the DMG taken over 5s.

530006.name: Flowers Ascension
530006.desc: When <linktext=1116><style="ItemQuality_5">Wild Seed</style></linktext> deals DMG or <linktext=1115><style="ItemQuality_5">Nourishing Seed</style></linktext> generates healing, you gain a <style="accent-gn">10%</style> Forest DMG bonus for the next <style="accent-gn">8</style>s.

510012.name: Smite Spec
510012.desc:
Further enhances the ability to use Wild Bloom.
Wild Bloom, Regen Pulse, and ​Nature Ward​ grant Symbiotic Mark to allies.
Symbiotic Mark: Lasts for 10s. All of the caster's DMG will heal allies with Symbiotic Mark for 45% of the DMG dealt.
Increases the final DMG of Lucky Strikes by 50%.
When overhealing a target with Symbiotic Mark, if the overheal reaches 30% of their Max HP, the excess healing is converted into a regeneration effect lasting for 10s. This effect can trigger only once every 30s.

Healing of Stillness: If the caster deals no DMG to enemies for 5s, each hit of the caster's Basic Attack will heal up to 10 allies (party members prioritized), with the 4-hit combo restoring 12.6% Max HP in total. After using an Ultimate, Basic Attacks immediately start healing, but this effect is disabled upon dealing DMG to enemies.

Capable of converting attacks into healing. Lucky Strikes from attacks trigger various healing effects, enhancing healing while increasing DMG dealt.

511013.name: Final Bloomwheel
511013.desc: When <linktext=1526><style="ItemQuality_5">Wild Bloom</style></linktext> deals DMG, reduces the remaining CD of <linktext=1530><style="ItemQuality_5">Infusion</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">1s</style>. If the DMG triggers a Lucky Strike, the remaining CD is reduced by <style="accent-gn">3s</style>.

507011.name: Healing Breath
507011.desc: When a <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style>, <style="accent-gn">Expertise Skill</style>, or <style="accent-gn">Ultimate</style> generates Healing, there is a <style="accent-gn">20%</style> to trigger <linktext=1109><style="ItemQuality_5">Healing Chain</style></linktext>. For every <style="accent-gn">2%</style> Luck, the chance +<style="accent-gn">1%</style>.

505013.name: Nature Shield
505013.desc:
When Wild Bloom heals a target, it also applies Nature Shield to them.
Targets with Nature Shield restore HP when hit, with the amount equal to 10% of your ATK. This effect can occur up to once per second.

502011.name: Inspiration
502011.desc: Applies <linktext=1107><style="ItemQuality_5">Inspiration</style></linktext> to yourself and allies within <style="accent-gn">30</style> meters.

501013.name: Intellect Conversion
501013.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">10</style> points of Intellect provides <style="accent-gn">1</style> point of MATK.

503011.name: Regen Bud
503011.desc:
Casting a Special Attack grants 1 Regen Bud.

Initial cap of Regen Buds: 4.
When an Expertise Skill or Ultimate generates healing, 2 Regen Buds are consumed to throw a Nourishing Seed, triggering up to once per second.
When an Expertise Skill or Ultimate deals DMG, 2 Regen Buds are consumed to shoot a Wild Seed, once per second.

24067.name: Defensive Blessing
24067.desc: <linktext=1107><style="ItemQuality_5">Inspiration</style></linktext> provides the target with an additional <style="accent-gn">650</style> Armor.

1307006.name: Flame Pursuit
1307006.desc: After using <style="accent-gn">3</style> <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style>s, the next <style="accent-gn">Basic Attack</style> hit triggers <linktext=1190><style="ItemQuality_5">Flame Pillar Blast</style></linktext>.

1305006.name: Melody: Heat Core
1305006.desc: <linktext=1133><style="ItemQuality_5">Melody</style></linktext> heals ally targets below <style="accent-gn">50%</style> HP with <style="accent-gn">100%</style> bonus effect.

1302006.name: Flame Pursuit II
1302006.desc: <linktext=1190><style="ItemQuality_5">Flame Pillar Blast</style></linktext> becomes a two-hit combo.

6558.name: Trio Rhapsody
6558.desc:
Rhapsody of Flame always appears in its most powerful form.
While in Rhapsody of Flame, ATK increases by Haste % x 0.6.

6557.name: Severed Chapter
6557.desc:
Increases Resilience Break Efficiency of self and Allies within 30 meters by 10%. This effect cannot stack.
After activating Heroic Melody, you and Allies within 30 meters have an resilience break efficiency +30% and deal 15% more DMG to Resilience Broken targets. This effect cannot stack.

1312006.name: Healing Note
1312006.desc:
Basic Attack deals an extra instance of DMG.
For every 5 Soundwave Energy obtained, creates a Note for the ally with the lowest HP.

1310006.name: Swing Reflux
1310006.desc: Hitting a target with <linktext=1615><style="ItemQuality_5">Fierce Strike</style></linktext> recovers <style="accent-gn">5</style> <style="accent-gn">Performance Energy</style>. <style="accent-gn">Each</style> additional target hit provides <style="accent-gn">1</style> extra <style="accent-gn">Performance Energy</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">10</style> total.

2401.name: Sound Blaze
2401.desc:
For every instance of damage equal to 10 times ATK, grants 1 Soundwave.
Soundwave can store up to 50.
When a skill that consumes Performance Passion deals damage, triggers Scorching Impact and consumes all Soundwave. Each 1 Soundwave increases Scorching Impact DMG by 16%, and each additional 1 target hit increases Scorching Impact multiplier DMG by 8% (up to 80%).

6085.name: Divine Concealment
6085.desc: Consuming <style="accent-gn">Courage</style> increases Haste by <style="accent-gn">1%</style> and Speed by <style="accent-gn">2%</style> for <style="accent-gn">5</style>s, stacking up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times.

401015.name: Swift Shadow
401015.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">50</style> points of <style="accent-gn">Courage</style> consumed reduces the CD of <linktext=1523><style="ItemQuality_5">Spiral Thrust</style></linktext>, <linktext=1522><style="ItemQuality_5">Breach Pursuit</style></linktext>, and <linktext=1524><style="ItemQuality_5">Falcon Toss</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">1</style>s.

402013.name: Vulnerable Strike
402013.desc:
Dealing DMG grants a fixed 30% chance to apply Vulnerability to the enemy.
Vulnerability: Increases the DMG you deal to the target by 10% for 5s.

429008.name: Tempestrike
429008.desc:
​Galeform​ applies Tempestrike when it ends (Recasting ​Galeform​ while it is active also triggers this effect).
During ​Galeform​, every 50 Courage or 3 Sharp consumed extends Tempestrike by 1s.

428022.name: Wind Split Technique
428022.desc: When <linktext=1153><style="ItemQuality_5">Rend</style></linktext> deals DMG, it has a fixed <style="accent-gn">50%</style> chance to grant <style="accent-gn">2</style> points of <style="accent-gn">Courage</style>.

6090.name: Quickshot Meteor
6090.desc:
Gale Thrust is enhanced, increasing hit counts by 2.
Reduces Gale Thrust's Courage consumption by 20%.

6091.name: Fearless Gale
6091.desc: After casting <linktext=1523><style="ItemQuality_5">Spiral Thrust</style></linktext> or <linktext=1522><style="ItemQuality_5">Breach Pursuit</style></linktext> or <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext>, the next <linktext=1517><style="ItemQuality_5">Gale Thrust</style></linktext> will not consume <style="accent-gn">Courage</style>. This effect is removed after leaving combat.

6096.name: Vigor Spike
6096.desc: When <linktext=1152><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp</style></linktext> reaches full amount and the caster is in combat, enters <linktext=1155><style="ItemQuality_5">Vigor Spike</style></linktext> state, effective up to once every <style="accent-gn">30s</style> (affected by CD Boost stats).

416010.name: Kamikaze Luck
416010.desc:
For each 1 stack of Sharp consumed, gains 3 points of Courage.
Increases Lucky Strike final DMG by 50%.

419010.name: Air Dance Strike
419010.desc:
Sharp Impact and its enhanced skill (Typhoon: Sharp Impact) cause the next ​Galeform​ to restore 50% more Courage.
Casting Sharp Impact immediately grants 3 Sharp. Casting its enhanced skill Typhoon: Sharp Impact immediately grants 6 Sharp.
Upon entering combat, immediately charges Sharp Impact to the max.

414010.name: Spear Recovery
414010.desc: <linktext=1156><style="ItemQuality_5">Spear Thrust</style></linktext> reduces the CD of <linktext=1524><style="ItemQuality_5">Falcon Toss</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">2s</style> (which can only be triggers once on multiple hits).

417010.name: Instant Edge Break Style
417010.desc:
Instant Edge consumes 1 more Sharp.
Increases the DMG dealt by Instant Edge by 90%.

420010.name: Sharp Advancement
420010.desc:
Enhances the effectiveness of Wind Fury by 50%.
When Instant Edge consumes Chasing Step, doubles the charge efficiency of Sharp Impact.

421010.name: Instantaneous Crit
421010.desc: While <linktext=1157><style="ItemQuality_5">Chasing Step</style></linktext> is active, <linktext=1519><style="ItemQuality_5">Instant Edge</style></linktext> and <linktext=1521><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp Impact</style></linktext> have their Crit Chance doubled. Additionally, for <linktext=1519><style="ItemQuality_5">Instant Edge</style></linktext> and <linktext=1521><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp Impact</style></linktext>, every <style="accent-gn">1%</style> excess Crit is converted into <style="accent-gn">3%</style> Crit DMG for the respective skill.

422010.name: Sharp Pursuit
422010.desc: When <linktext=1519><style="ItemQuality_5">Instant Edge</style></linktext> consumes <linktext=1157><style="ItemQuality_5">Chasing Step</style></linktext>, grants <style="accent-gn">1</style> stack of <linktext=1152><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp</style></linktext>.

418011.name: Chasing Step
418011.desc:
When Skyfall or Falcon Toss deals a Crit or Lucky Strike, they trigger Chasing Step.
When Skyfall or Falcon Toss trigger a Crit and Lucky Strike simultaneously, they grant 2 stacks of Chasing Step.

425023.name: Momentum Surge
425023.desc: Increases <linktext=1152><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp</style></linktext> effect by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>, and for <style="accent-gn">each</style> enemy within <style="accent-gn">12m</style>, additionally increases by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">3%</style>.

6101.name: Spear Thrust
6101.desc:
When Skyfall lands a Lucky Strike, it triggers Spear Thrust, once every 2s.
Dealing DMG with Spear Thrust restores 8 points of Courage. This effect triggers only once, even if multiple targets are hit.

6104.name: Sharp Echo
6104.desc: If <linktext=1152><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp</style></linktext> isn't at Max stacks, increases the DMG dealt by <linktext=1520><style="ItemQuality_5">Skyfall</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">25%</style>.

432008.name: Skyward Spec
432008.desc:
Replaces Special Attack with Skyfall and enhances the skill.
When having Sharp, gains ATK based on the max number of Sharp.

Skyfall and Instant Edge can chain together, skipping the aerial cast delay. High Luck and critical rate enable Skyfall to trigger a low-cost Instant Edge.

406014.name: Wind Tear
406014.desc: When <linktext=1517><style="ItemQuality_5">Gale Thrust</style></linktext> deals DMG, apply <linktext=1153><style="ItemQuality_5">Rend</style></linktext> to targets.

411014.name: Strong Attack
411014.desc: When <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext> deals DMG, reduces the CD of Ultimate by <style="accent-gn">0.5s</style> (which can only be triggers <style="accent-gn">once</style> on multiple hits).

410014.name: Swift Blade
410014.desc: When <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext> deals DMG, it has a fixed <style="accent-gn">7%</style> chance to evolve <style="accent-gn">Basic Attacks</style> into <linktext=1592><style="ItemQuality_5">Swift Blade</style></linktext>.

405014.name: Wind Rift Diffusion
405014.desc: <style="accent-gn">Expertise</style> and <style="accent-gn">Ultimates</style> deal <style="accent-gn">10%</style> more DMG to targets inflicted with <linktext=1153><style="ItemQuality_5">Rend</style></linktext>, and when hitting <linktext=1153><style="ItemQuality_5">Rend</style></linktext> targets, deal <style="accent-gn">1</style> additional hit of <style="accent-gn">75%</style> DMG.

407014.name: Wind Gate Drake Cannon
407014.desc: Every <style="accent-gn">22</style> triggers of <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext> allows <style="accent-gn">Basic Attack</style> to evolve into <linktext=1591><style="ItemQuality_5">Drake Cannon</style></linktext> in <style="accent-gn">10s</style>.

412015.name: Breath of Wind
412015.desc: Skills that consume <style="accent-gn">Courage</style> (<linktext=1523><style="ItemQuality_5">Spiral Thrust</style></linktext> and its enhanced skills, <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext>, <linktext=1524><style="ItemQuality_5">Falcon Toss</style></linktext> and its enhanced skills, <linktext=1517><style="ItemQuality_5">Gale Thrust</style></linktext>) gain <style="accent-gn">6%</style> Wind Bonus.

413014.name: Vortex Strike
413014.desc: After every <style="accent-gn">2</style> casts of <linktext=1591><style="ItemQuality_5">Drake Cannon</style></linktext>, your <linktext=1523><style="ItemQuality_5">Spiral Thrust</style></linktext> evolves into <linktext=1590><style="ItemQuality_5">Vortex Strike</style></linktext>.

35105.name: Wind Chaser
35105.desc: During the casting of <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext>, for every <style="accent-gn">20</style> points of <style="accent-gn">Courage</style> consumed, increase the DMG of <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext> by <style="accent-gn">4%</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">20%</style>.

43048.name: Zephyr Waltz Agility
43048.desc: Additional <style="accent-gn">Courage</style> recovery: Recovers <style="accent-gn">1</style> extra point of <style="accent-gn">Courage</style> per second for every <style="accent-gn">2</style> stacks of <linktext=1152><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp</style></linktext>.

1503.name: Rapid Drake Cannon
1503.desc: After every <style="accent-gn">3</style> casts of <linktext=1592><style="ItemQuality_5">Swift Blade</style></linktext>, your <style="accent-gn">Basic Attacks</style> evolve into <linktext=1591><style="ItemQuality_5">​Drake Cannon​</style></linktext> for the next <style="accent-gn">10</style>s.

1504.name: Sharp Long Breath
1504.desc: During <linktext=1187><style="ItemQuality_5">Wind Fury</style></linktext>, <linktext=1524><style="ItemQuality_5">Falcon Toss</style></linktext> evolves into <linktext=1589><style="ItemQuality_5">Azure Sever</style></linktext> <style="accent-gn">once</style>.

433007.name: Vanguard Spec
433007.desc:
Further enhances the ability to use Gale Thrust.
Casting Gale Thrust has a fixed 20% chance to make Basic Attacks evolve into Swift Blade. Every 1 Sharp increases this chance by 5%. The first Gale Thrust after entering combat immediately fills Sharp to max.

Maximize the efficiency of gaining and consuming Courage to reduce the CD of Expertise Skills. Haste increases the efficiency of gaining Courage and the casting speed of core Expertise Skills.

434012.name: Battle Cry
434012.desc:
Typhoon Cleave raises the banner spear, granting Inspire to the caster and increasing the caster's Crit DMG by 50% for 10s. Afterward, launches into enemy lines with a follow-up leap, dealing Attack DMG to enemies in range and knocking them airborne. Restores 100 Courage.
Inspire: Lasts for 10s. During this time, Haste +15%. You restore 10 Courage per sec and 1 stack of Sharp every 2s.

434011.name: Battle Cry
434011.desc:
Typhoon Cleave raises the banner spear, granting Inspire to the caster and increasing the caster's Crit DMG by 50% for 10s. Afterward, launches into enemy lines with a follow-up leap, dealing Attack DMG to enemies in range and knocking them airborne. Restores 100 Courage.
Inspire: Lasts for 10s. During this time, Haste +15%. You restore 10 Courage per sec and 1 stack of Sharp every 2s.

423011.name: Divine Wind Support
423011.desc: When <linktext=1524><style="ItemQuality_5">Falcon Toss</style></linktext> and its enhanced skill (<linktext=1589><style="ItemQuality_5">Azure Sever</style></linktext>), or <linktext=1519><style="ItemQuality_5">Instant Edge</style></linktext> hits <style="accent-gn">1</style> target, the DMG gains a <style="accent-gn">10%</style> Wind bonus.

423012.name: Momentum Surge
423012.desc: Increases <linktext=1152><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp</style></linktext> effect by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>, and for <style="accent-gn">each</style> enemy within <style="accent-gn">12m</style>, additionally increases by <style="accent-gn">1%</style>, up to <style="accent-gn">3%</style>.

438001.name: Sharp
438001.desc: When <style="accent-gn">Strength</style> reaches <style="accent-gn">500</style> points, the additional ATK from <linktext=1152><style="ItemQuality_5">Sharp</style></linktext> increases to <style="accent-gn">6%</style>.

6681.name: Double Inferno
6681.desc: Whirlwind Slash inflicts 1 stack of Burn on hit targets, and an additional 2 stacks on the main target.

6681.name: Time Wheel Agile Soul
6681.desc: Each level of the Formless effect grants 3% Agility.

6681.name: Soaring Flame
6681.desc:
After gaining Formless 6 times or activating Wasteland's End, Blazing Ascension evolves into Soaring Flame.
Gains Blaze after casting Soaring Flame.

6681.name: Formless Combo
6681.desc: Every 5 times Expertise Skills deal damage to the main target, gains a buff increasing Blazing Ascension damage by 5% for the next 5s. Stacks up to 5 times.

6681.name: Wild Soul - Break
6681.desc: When Agility reaches 500 points, Expertise Skill DMG +5%.

6681.name: Swift Turn
6681.desc: For every <style="accent-gn">1%</style> Haste, gains <style="accent-gn">1%</style> Attack SPD.

6681.name: Crimson Lotus Ember Epiphany
6681.desc: While in Infernal Combo state, Suppress effect +50%.

6681.name: Crimson Lotus Duality
6681.desc:
Each stack of Infernal Combo grants effects based on the relationship between Luck Chance and Crit Rate:

When Luck Chance is greater than or equal to Crit Rate, Lucky Strike Multiplier +10%.
When Crit Rate is greater than Luck Chance, Crit DMG +10%.

6681.name: Crimson Lotus
6681.desc:
Gain adaptive effects when Infernal Combo reaches max stacks:

Formless Spec: ATK +10%.
Crimson Spec: Crimson Recovery effect +10%.

6681.name: Crimson Flame Pursuit
6681.desc: Special Attack hits cause the target to take +2.5% DMG. The effect lasts 8s and stacks up to 3 times.

6681.name: Flame Soul Seal
6681.desc:
Flame Soul cap +50.
Grants Infernal Combo when Flame Soul increases.

6681.name: Rescue
6681.desc: Healing Expertise heal targets with less than 50% HP +25%.

6681.name: Energy Expansion
6681.desc:
Energy cap +20.
Casting Blossom Charge restores 30% of lost energy.

6681.name: Healing Pulse
6681.desc: When an enemy within 10 meters that you have attacked is defeated, a Healing Pulse is generated, occurring up to once every 10s.

6681.name: Floral Whisper
6681.desc: Healing Expertise generate 20% more healing, but healing from Life Bloom -50%.

6681.name: Instant Bloom
6681.desc: After casting Life Bloom 10 times, the next Grove Wish or Regen Pulse within 15s has a Cast Speed of +100% and healing of +10%.

6681.name: Tricolor Revelation
6681.desc:
Consuming Moonlight Solace triggers Flower Dance - Tricolor Revelation.
Flower Dance - Tricolor Revelation - Gain all Flower Stalk effects, this effect can only occur once every 60s.

6681.name: Energy Arcane
6681.desc: During Growth Arcane, energy recovery speed +50%.

6681.name: Blooming Reincarnation
6681.desc: Casting Life Bloom increases its healing by 20% for the next 4s and energy consumption by 10%, stacking up to 5 times.

6681.name: Flourishing Progress
6681.desc: Casting Blossom Charge no longer consumes Regen Buds.

6681.name: Flourishing Flower
6681.desc: When in the Grass Field, the appearance time of Flower Stalks is accelerated by 50%.

6681.name: Endless Blossom
6681.desc: When casting Blossom Charge, Grove Wish, or Regen Pulse, 20% chance that the next cast of Life Bloom within 5s consumes no Energy.

6681.name: Verdant Nourishment
6681.desc:
When you have the Nourish effect, all damage taken -10%.
Targets with the Nourish effect receive +2% healing, and if Nourish is equal to or greater than 3 stacks, they receive an additional +2% healing.

6681.name: Wild Luck
6681.desc: When Wild Bloom and Regen Pulse deal damage, there is a chance of luck%/2 to gain 1 Regen Bud. If affected by Thorns, the trigger chance is doubled.

6681.name: Thornbreaker
6681.desc:
When Infusion deals damage, it applies Tearto the target.
Rend: Thorns damage received +100% for 2s.

6681.name: Thorn
6681.desc:
Wild Seed inflicts Thorn on the targets hit.
You deal 5% more Verdant DMG to the targets with Thorn.

6681.name: Swift Shelter
6681.desc: Each time Regen Pulse is cast or triggered, it reduces the remaining CD time of Nature Ward by 2s.

6681.name: Healing Pulse
6681.desc: When an enemy within 10 meters that you have attacked is defeated, a Healing Pulse is generated, occurring up to once every 10s.

6681.name: Breath of Symbiosis
6681.desc: Symbiotic Mark conversion healing amount +2%. Every 5% Mastery provides an additional +1%.

6681.name: Swift Bud
6681.desc: For each Regen Bud gained, the remaining CD time of Feral Seed -1s.

6681.name: Verdant Impact
6681.desc: For every 20 stacks of Pulse Echo, the next Regen Pulse will end with a burst of Verdant Impact at your location.

439001.name: Catcher
439001.desc: In combat, for every <style="accent-gn">1</style> enemy target defeated (party-wide effect), ATK +<style="accent-gn">80</style> for <style="accent-gn">30</style>s, up to <style="accent-gn">800</style>.

439001.name: Battle Howl
439001.desc: While Wildcall is active, the Wild Wolf is bound to deal Crit DMG.

439001.name: Lumi Torrent
439001.desc: In Photon Reforge state, Torrent Volley continuously charges, and after 30s of charging, it evolves into Lumi Torrent.

439001.name: Direwolf Bite
439001.desc: The Wild Wolf's Coordinated Attack has a 30% fixed chance to inflict Bleed.

439001.name: Stomp
439001.desc: Within 10s after Casting Wild Call, Casting Wild Call again can command all Companions in combat to immediately cast Trample.

439001.name: Demon Wolf Twin
439001.desc: When dealing DMG in battle, Storm Arrow has a fixed 10% chance to summon a Wild Wolf for 8s. Once every 30s.

439001.name: Phantom Wolfstrike
439001.desc:
The Wild Wolf's Coordinated Attack grants a fixed 30% chance to summon a Phantom Direwolves, which pounces on the enemy.
Pounce and Bite always inflicts Bleed. If the target is already bleeding, the pounce is bound to deal Crit DMG.

439001.name: Wildpack Spec
439001.desc:
Enhances usage of Storm Arrow and synergy with the Wild Wolf.
When Photon Reforge is not activated, using Storm Arrow grants the Wild Wolf a fixed 25% chance to launch a Coordinated Attack. During Photon Reforge, doubles the chance.

439001.name: Overcharge
439001.desc: When Basic Attacks deal DMG, there is a 5% fixed chance to instantly grant Special Attack 1 charge, up to the maximum charge limit.

439001.name: Dexterity
439001.desc: When agility reaches 500 points, attack speed +5%.

439001.name: Photon Limit
439001.desc:
When Wildpack Spec is active, increases Max Photon Energy by 20, and extends the duration of Photon Reforge.
If Falconry Spec is active, reduces Max Photon Energy by 20, and enables faster access to Photon Reforge.

439001.name: Rapid Shot
439001.desc: Every 5% haste provides an additional 1% attack speed.

439001.name: Wolf Pact
439001.desc:
Tames a Wild Wolf to fight alongside you. Storm Arrow has a 30% fixed chance to trigger Coordinated Attack.

Wild Wolf
Fights alongside you.
Basic Attack: Sweeps the enemy, dealing Attack Damage equal to 50% ATK (which scales with the Level/Tier of your Basic Attack).
Coordinated Attack: Wild Wolf leaps to the enemy and bites, dealing Attack Damage equal to 80% ATK (which scales with the Level/Tier of your Basic Attack).

439001.name: Life Enhancement
439001.desc: When Strength reaches 500 points, Max HP +12%.

439001.name: Haste Sigil
439001.desc: Each 1% Haste accelerates the REG SPD of Holy Sigils by 1%.

439001.name: Condemn Time Limit
439001.desc: When Condemn deals damage, immediately cool down 1 Holy Decree (prioritizing the one with the longest remaining CD).

439001.name: Blessing of Holy Sigil
439001.desc: When using a Skill that consumes Holy Sigils, gains a 20% fixed chance to allow the next such Skill does not consume the Sigil. The effect lasts 8s or until a Sigil-consuming Skill is used.

439001.name: Condemn
439001.desc: When using a Skill that consumes Photon Energy, gains a 15% fixed chance to allow Basic Attack to evolve into Condemn.

439001.name: Holy Summon
439001.desc: When Shield Toss or Judgment deals damage, 10% chance to trigger Holy Strike. If Crit DMG is dealt, trigger chance increases to 30%.

439001.name: Aegis Ward's Anthem
439001.desc: Every 2 Holy Sigils consumed reduces the CD of Aegis Ward by 1s.

439001.name: Sword Dance
439001.desc: When Expertise critically heal, gain 15% healing bonus.

439001.name: Fearless Shield
439001.desc: Each time Shield Toss deals DMG, there's a fixed 50% chance to grant the Lightforged Body a Light Shield equal to 100% ATK.

440001.name: Dragon's Fury Flame
440001.desc:
The Crit chance of ​Drake Cannon​ and ​Vortex Strike​ is doubled.
Increases the Crit DMG of Drake Cannon and Vortex Strike by 8%.
Each 1% Haste grants 0.5% Crit DMG for Drake Cannon​ and ​Vortex Strike​.

442001.name: Break Pursuit Advancement
442001.desc: Within <style="accent-gn">15s</style> after Casting the <style="accent-gn">Ultimate</style>, Casting <linktext=1522><style="ItemQuality_5">Breach Pursuit</style></linktext> will not start CD. This effect is removed after the duration ends or after Casting <style="accent-gn">3</style> times <linktext=1522><style="ItemQuality_5">Breach Pursuit</style></linktext>.

443002.name: Frostbeam Spec
443002.desc:
Replaces Special Attack with ​Frostbeam​ and enhances the skill.
Every Frost Crystal increases ​Frostbeam​ DMG by 15%. Each 10% Mastery grants an additional 0.85% DMG bonus (up to 5%) and increases the Ice Energy consumed by 30%.
When ​Frostbeam​ hits a target, every 13 hits reduce the remaining CD of Permafrostby 1s (hitting multiple targets only counts once).

Consumes Ice Energy to channel Frostbeam continuously at the target. High Haste and Mastery greatly speed up its channeling while improving Ice Energy recovery.

443002.name: Frost Tide
443002.desc: When Frost Beam deals damage, 20% chance to directly gain Frost Crystal. If Frost Crystal is at its maximum, gain 5% Iceal bonus for 3s.

443002.name: Frost Revelation
443002.desc: Tidepoolfirst hit restores 5 points of Ice Energy, with an additional 5 points of Ice Energy restored for each extra Ice Limit.

443002.name: Continuous Stream
443002.desc:
When dealing damage, trigger Trickle.
Trickle: Gain 1% Ice bonus, lasts for 6s, up to 5 stacks.

443002.name: Icy Calm
443002.desc: For each additional target hit by Expertise or Ultimates (up to 5), mastery or haste or critical or luck +2% (based on the highest attribute), lasts for 5s.

443002.name: Intellect Ice Crystal
443002.desc: Every 50 points of Intellect provide 1 point of maximum Frost Crystal (maximum Frost Crystal obtained through this method does not exceed 100).

443002.name: Tide Mastery
443002.desc: When Casting Frostbeam, you can channel and cast Tidepool.

443002.name: Endless Tide
443002.desc: During Permafrost, Casting Tidepoolcan extend its duration by 3s.

443002.name: Cold Wind Convergence
443002.desc:
When Frozen Gale hits a target (only triggers once when hitting multiple targets), it consumes all Frosts to summon Ice Crystal Fall, with the number of Ice Crystal Falls equal to the consumed Frosts.
Ice Crystal Fall deals damage, recovers 5 Ice Energy, and reduces the Ice Energy cost of skills by 5% for the next 5s, stacking up to 4 times.

444002.name: Fortitude
444002.desc:
During Valor Cyclone, gains Super Armor and reduces DMG taken by 20%.
When Valor Cyclone deals DMG, restores HP equal to 10% ATK.

444002.name: Crystal Resonance
444002.desc: When Frostbeam deals damage, it has a fixed 10% chance to make Ice Crystal Core cast Ice Arrow.

444002.name: Frost Explosion
444002.desc: Ice Arrows cast by Ice Crystal Core can deal an additional 100% ATK Magic Damage, and this damage is area damage.

445001.name: Wind Rise
445001.desc: When <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext> deals DMG, increases <linktext=1591><style="ItemQuality_5">Drake Cannon</style></linktext> and <linktext=1590><style="ItemQuality_5">Vortex Strike</style></linktext> Crit Chance by <style="accent-gn">7%</style>, and Crit DMG by <style="accent-gn">5%</style>. The effect lasts <style="accent-gn">5s</style> and stacks up to <style="accent-gn">7</style> times.

446001.name: Rupture
446001.desc: When <linktext=1518><style="ItemQuality_5">Valor Cyclone</style></linktext> deals DMG, it has a fixed <style="accent-gn">50%</style> chance to inflict <linktext=1154><style="ItemQuality_5">Rupture</style></linktext>.

447001.name: Wind Spiral
447001.desc:
When Gale Thrust deals DMG to the main target, it has a fixed 50% chance to grant 1 stack of Wind Spiral (the chance increases by 5% for each additional target hit, and a single cast can grant up to 6 stacks) for 20s, stacking up to 10 times.
Wind Spiral: When casting Spiral Thrust or Valor Cyclone, it triggers a Spiral Explosion, dealing Attack DMG equal to Wind Spiral stacks × 200% ATK to nearby enemies. Each 1% of Mastery increases this DMG multiplier by 7%. This DMG cannot Crit, and decreases by 3% for each additional target hit, down to a minimum of 46%. Triggering this clears all Wind Spiral stacks.

447001.name: Secondary Amp
447001.desc: Increases the highest among Crit, Haste, Luck, Mastery, and Versatility by +5%.

447001.name: Ice Revelation
447001.desc:
Gain 2 permanent Ice Crystal Cores floating around you.
Ice Crystal Core
When normal attacks deal damage, Ice Crystal Core has a fixed 10% chance to cast 2 Ice Arrows.
Ice Arrow: Deals 50% ATK Magic Damage to enemy targets and gains 1 Frost, up to a maximum of 2 Frosts.

447001.name: Ice Comet
447001.desc: When Intellect reaches 500 points, gain 5% Ice bonus.

447001.name: Intellect Cooling
447001.desc: When Intellect reaches 300 points, skill CD -10%.

447001.name: Rapid Thunder Assault
447001.desc: For each additional Thunder Sigil consumed by a skill, damage +3%.

447001.name: Instant Slash
447001.desc: Instant Iaido Slash hitting the target reduces the target's Armor by 6% for 5s, stacking up to 5 layers.

447001.name: Keen Strike
447001.desc: Normal attacks have a fixed 10% chance to trigger Piercing Slash, effective at most once per second.

447001.name: Blade Intent
447001.desc: Gain 3 points of Blade Intent when releasing Expertise.

447001.name: Thunder Charm Blade
447001.desc: For each Thunder Sigil consumed by a Expertise Skill, gain an additional 3 points of Blade Intent.

447001.name: Vacuum Slash
447001.desc:
Each time Flash or Raijin Dash is cast, stack 1 layer of Thundrage. When Thundrage accumulates to 5 layers, Iaido Slash evolves into Thunder Cut.
After Casting Thunder Cut, consume 5 layers of Thundrage, Thundrage can stack up to 8 layers.

447001.name: Blade Intent Thunderstrike
447001.desc: When Iaido Slash deals Crit DMG, if the Blade Intent is greater than 20 points, trigger Thunder Strike (Iaido Slash can trigger only once per use).

447001.name: Thunder Sigil Rewind
447001.desc: When consuming Thunder Sigils, there is a chance to return 1 Thunder Sigil. For each additional Thunder Sigil consumed, the return chance +8%.

447001.name: Keen Enhancement
447001.desc: Fixed trigger chance of Piercing Slash +10%.

447001.name: Iai Thunder Dance
447001.desc: When Thunder Sigil is greater than or equal to 3, Special Attacks will attack twice consecutively.

447001.name: Shadow Veil
447001.desc: Each enemy within 3 meters increases Block chance by 3%, up to 15%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.)

447001.name: Stone Domain
447001.desc:
throughout the duration of Sandshroud, being attacked reduces the attack speed of enemy targets within 5 meters by 30%, lasting for 3s.
